points.description: First challenge: a valid challenge from the model answer is named (e.g. adaptation to topology changes, security, medium access control/hidden-exposed-near-far terminals, QoS, scalability, heterogeneity, dependability, power consumption) AND described correctly in line with the model answer.
points.partial_credit: Half marks (0.25) if only named with no or vague description, or described correctly but the name/term is missing or the description has a minor error.

points.description: Second, different challenge: a valid challenge from the model answer is named AND described correctly in line with the model answer.
points.partial_credit: Half marks (0.25) if only named with no or vague description, or described correctly but the name/term is missing or the description has a minor error.

rubric.notes: Full marks need two different challenges from the model answer's list, each named and briefly described (e.g. power consumption: battery-powered devices so routing must save energy). A challenge that is only named, or only vaguely described, earns half of that point. Challenges that are wrong or not wireless/mobile-specific earn nothing, and a repeated or merged challenge counts once.
